This excellent little set is a perfect starter socket set for people needing both metric and SAE sockets. Comes with one 3/8 ratchet that actually surprised me because it's very good quality for this type of a set. It has 72 teeth and a smooth operation that's not too far off from my more expensive Gearwrench ratchets. Includes an adapter for 1/4 inch sockets since 20 of the 30 sockets are 1/4 inch drive. If your vehicle uses a lot of Torx bits, those are easy to purchase and add to this set.

This set comes in a nice blow molded case with locking latches. Great to throw in the back of your car or just have on a shelf for minor auto repair or home projects. This set is made in Taiwan but the quality is a lot better than I was expecting. Black and Decker is considered an entry level brand but they do make some decent stuff sometimes and this is one of the nicer tool sets I've seen from them. I'm using this as a home socket set so I don't have to go to the garage anytime I need a socket set for something in the house, which seems to happen a lot in my older home. Great set, no major complaints. I guess the 1/4 inch drive handle seems sort of cheap but that's about it.

user_history.review_text:
So often my hands are covered with paint and I don’t want to transfer that on to anything where I will then have to clean up another item. I absolutely love the touchless feature of this faucet. By waving your hand in front of the faucet the water turns on for 3 minutes allowing you to wash and rinse your hand or whatever you may need with out ever touching the faucet. Just brilliant!

I am not the most handy and when it comes to any plumbing or electrical projects I get a little help from my incredible friends 😉 - so this review is of our combined impressions.

Everything was perfectly laid out within the box - making it easy to check that we had all the parts prior to starting the project. The instructions were easy to follow and understand.

Once we removed my old faucet, which had been in place for 20 years (by far the hardest part of the project), the installation of the new faucet took about a half hour and was no problem.

The set came complete with all of the tubes and fitting needed, the battery powered motion control water saving control box (4 AA batteries not included), sink plate that will cover any holes in your sink you don’t use, as well as several others in case you happened to require changing the nuts from your water lines to match the faucets, which we did not.

The faucet feels and looks like much more expensive faucets by other brands. Having a tall gooseneck design it easily swings between either sink making it incredibly convenient to use.

In addition to this flexibility the spray head pulls free of the faucet to reach almost the bottom of the sink. The spray head has a locking buttons allowing you to choose between the normal full faucet stream, a sweeping stream, or a powerful spray used to rinse dishes. There is a counterweight under the sink on the tube that feeds water to the spray head, so when released it returns the head to being locked within the faucet.

The temperature controls are easy to use and adjust with one hand by simply pushing outward to turn the water on, pushing back for hot and forward for cold.

By changing from my old faucet to this new one I no longer needed the separate dish sprayer so was able to add a built in soap pump (not included).

We have used this kitchen faucet for a few months now without any issue whatsoever. The batteries have lasted this entire time without needing to be changed and having the touchless feature has come in handy more times than I can count.

In relation to form, function and ease of installation I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend this kitchen faucet. I absolutely love it.

user_history.review_text:
Most of us who have done carpentry work are familiar with the products that work as these do. The name brand models will cost about double what these do.

They all work about the same way. The fixed end can be slid anywhere on the bar, spun around and fixed in place - the trigger activated clamp is then used to either pull or push by placing it against the material and pulling the trigger.

While these by XINQIAO are not as heavy duty as the name brand models, I have been using them for the last several months without issue. My only complaint is the red non-marring rubber pads can tend to slip off. In an effort not to lose these I put a dab of silicone glue behind them and clamped them closed overnight - issue resolved.

These are not as heavy duty or as well made as their name brand counterparts but they cost half of what the others cost. The vast majority of the time I don’t need the force the name brand clamps offer and these work just as well for my purposes.

These clamps are a quality product that work well. They are not as stout as the name brand models but they will serve well for the vast majority of clamping or spreading needs. After using these for the last several months I don’t hesitate to recommend them as a budget quick-grip clamp.
